summary.name: Duckie
summary.one_liner: Duckie is an agentic platform that lets support teams build AI agents to resolve tickets, investigate issues, and automate support workflows.
use_cases: Resolving customer support tickets end to end
Onboarding and compliance workflows for support teams
summary.what_it_does: Duckie is a platform where support teams build their own AI agents for tasks such as resolving tickets, investigating issues, and triaging escalations. Users describe the desired behavior in plain English, for example checking a plan in Stripe, offering a retention discount, and then updating the subscription. The page says agents can connect to any tool via MCP, APIs, or native integrations. It also says teams can choose among multiple frontier models and orchestrate agents on a single canvas with centralized management. One customer case study describes use for financial-services workflows such as walking ledgers and handling branching cancellations.
notable: Plain-English workflow authoring with no engineers required
Connects to tools via MCP, APIs, and native integrations
Choice of multiple frontier AI models
Central canvas for orchestrating multiple agents
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Page is mostly marketing; specific capabilities and limits are not detailed
